## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and focused, and clearly described
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `poetry run pytest` passes
- [ ] `poetry run mypy limitsdb`, `poetry run ruff check .` and
      `poetry run ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Public documentation updated when behavior changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-facing
- [ ] No credentials, decrypted secrets, or production data included
